# Chapter 3: The Unwritten Future

---

## Historical Context

Bob does not know how his story ends. None of us do. The future remains unwritten, as it has always been, as it will always be. Yet for Bob, this uncertainty carries particular weight. Having survived losses that seemed unsurvivable — the aplastic anemia of his daughter, the accumulated attrition of friendships and contemporaries through death, the quiet devastations that punctuate every long life — Bob has learned to hold the future
